output.summary: An aromatic, palm-like tree native to Southeast Asia, the Andaman Islands and the Philippines, and also found wild in southern India and Burma. It has spiny, fragrant leaves, brace roots and highly scented flowers used for perfume. Its soft shoots are very astringent and considered inedible unless blanched, after which they taste like bamboo shoots.
output.edibilityNote: Soft shoots are eaten after blanching; untreated shoots are very astringent and considered inedible.
